name: Sz 130
notes: Compact Class II disk with a faint outer ring; ALMA Band 7 0.87 mm (Curone et al. 2026)

images.wavelength_label: 0.87 mm continuum (343.5 GHz; robust 0.5; compact inner disk plus faint 18 au outer ring)

paper.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks

images.note: Panel label inside figure: Sz 130. Inner component R68 = 1.68 au (0.0107") - smallest disk in the sample; with the faint outer ring R68 = 19.47 au (0.1233"). The inner emission component is smooth (no substructure within 10 au), but a faint outer gap/ring pair is detected (D8 at 8.1 au / B18 at 18.0 au; ring carries 3.0 mJy = 56% of the total flux), only visible in the saturated robust-2.0 image. Beam 22x14 mas = 3.5x2.2 au, PA_b = 65 deg; F_nu = 5.33 +/- 0.48 mJy; rms 35 uJy/beam. EB 22 Jul 2025.
